description: This file is a Node.js script written in ECMAScript Module (ESM) syntax, primarily intended for automation tasks related to build, snapshotting, diffing, and monitoring a project's filesystem and build process. It defines various functions for argument parsing, directory management, process control, and data collection, and contains a main execution flow that orchestrates build and runtime checks.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments, overriding default options with provided flags.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory and its parents if they do not exist.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes in file paths for consistency.

methods.name: listTreeEntries
methods.description: Recursively lists all files and directories under a given root directory.

methods.name: humanBytes
methods.description: Formats a byte count into a human-readable string with units.

methods.name: snapshotTree
methods.description: Generates a filesystem snapshot including counts and sizes of files, directories, and symlinks.

methods.name: writeSnapshot
methods.description: Creates a snapshot of the directory structure and filesystem stats at a point in time.

methods.name: runCheckedCommand
methods.description: Executes a command synchronously, throwing an error if it fails.

methods.name: sleep
methods.description: Returns a Promise that resolves after a specified delay.

methods.name: buildTimedWatchCommand
methods.description: Constructs a command object for running the watch process with timing.

methods.name: parseTimingFile
methods.description: Reads and parses timing information from a file generated by the 'time' command.

methods.name: runTimedWatch
methods.description: Runs the watch process with timing, handling termination and collecting logs.

methods.name: parsePathFile
methods.description: Reads path entries from a file into an array.

methods.name: writeDiffArtifacts
methods.description: Computes differences between two directory snapshots, writing added and removed paths.

methods.name: fail
methods.description: Logs an error message to the console.

methods.name: detectWatchBuildReason
methods.description: Analyzes stdout/stderr to determine the reason for a rebuild triggered during watching.

methods.name: buildRunNodeDeps
methods.description: Prepares environment info and paths needed for dependencies.

methods.name: main
methods.description: The main async function orchestrating the build, snapshot, watch, diff, and analysis workflow.
